lines.en: I walk slowly between the trunks.
My vines trail on the ground.
I take my steps one segment at a time.
I head toward that big tree.
I go around the roots.
I look up for the tenderest leaves.
I shift my body into the sun.
I cross a bed of ferns.
My horns scrape a low branch.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往林子深处。
lines.en: I go step by step deeper into the wood.
I stop and sniff.
I turn slowly around the trunk.
I stand with my vines swaying.
I lift my face to the leaves.
I hold still like a tree.
Sunlight lies on my back.
I close my mouth and chew slowly.
The wind passes through my horns.
I turn slowly around.
I listen to the sounds of the wood.
I smell of leaves.
I huff through my nose.
I make no stir at all.
I press a foot into the leaf litter.
I look up at the canopy again.
My lids close heavily once.
I stoop my head toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有叶子的气味。
lines.en: You carry no smell of leaves.
I size you up with my head tilted.
I give half a step your way.
One lift of your hand and I back off.
I turn my horns to you slowly.
Are you going to touch my leaves?
I stand much taller than you.
I let my hands fall low.
I snort a breath at you.
A stretch of grass lies between us.
I slowly twist my body away.

lines.zh: 我把头抬高，从上往下看你。
lines.en: I raise my head and look down at you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把叶子吹动了。
lines.en: My breath stirs the leaves.
I am taken by a slow curiosity.

lines.zh: 我朝你身后的林子看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance at the trees behind you.
I give half a step and my vines tangle.
That blow came into my flank.
I lower my upper body.
I straighten slowly again.
A layer of my leaves falls.
Hurting, I have not gone down.
I retreat toward the tree.
I pant heavily.
I keep that in my vine joints.
I draw my vines in tight.
That is the smell of young leaves.
I lower my head to it.
I bite off most of it.
This is sweet.
I grind the leaf in my mouth slowly.
I look up for more.
I follow your hand.
You raise the leaves and I raise my head.
Bits of leaf line my mouth.
When done I nod slightly.
This is tenderer than what grows on the tree.
I roll up the rest and take it.
The knock sets me back half a step.
I am heavy; I cannot be shoved.
I turn my body aside.
My leg knocks against yours.
I look down at you.
I shift a step aside.

lines.zh: 我身上的藤被扯了一下。
lines.en: A vine of mine is tugged.
This crowded, I cannot turn.
I nail myself where I stand.
Stop knocking into me.

lines.zh: 我在这一带有自己的地盘。
lines.en: I have my own ground here.
I reach a vine across.
It leans in and rubs against me.
We lower our heads to eat leaves.
My shoulder rests on its shoulder.
It moves and I follow.
Neither of us makes a sound.
I ease it away.
I go back to my leaves.
I bite the branch.

lines.zh: 我把叶从枝条上捋下来。
lines.en: I strip the leaves off the branch.
Too thick for me to bite.
I dip and bite the stem through.
My mouth is too full to close.
I grind it fine bit by bit.
Not fresh; I spit it out.
I set it down by my feet.
A ring of green froth at my mouth.
I look for the next branch.
Something moves in the wood.
I lift my head toward it.
I stare it dead.
I crouch down.
I shift toward it.
It is too near my tree.
I draw my vines in.
My stance is set.
I close in step by step.
I growl low at it.
I work my way over step by step.
It is making too much noise.
I face its front without moving.
It loops and I turn my body with it.
I stand between it and the tree.

lines.zh: 它跨近，我沉下半个身位。
lines.en: It steps in and I sink half a body.
I have plenty of time.
I point my horns at it.
My vines spread at my sides.
It withdraws and I cannot be bothered.
Any nearer and I strike.
It has lost its order.
I spread my vines out.
It cannot get around my tree.
I drop my head and butt with my horns.
I whip it with a vine.
I slam a hoof down.
That tips it onto the ground.
It cuts down and my thick hide takes it.
I headbutt once more.
I drive it to the tree.
It draws off and I stop.
I have lost a good many leaves.
I pant and stand straight.
I coil a vine round its leg.
I hook it away with my horns.
I step out from the tree shade.
The trees are dense here.

lines.zh: 我先仰起脖子看看树冠。
lines.en: I lift my neck to check the canopy.
The leaves rustle above me.
I walk toward the newest shoots.
I slowly stretch out my spine.

lines.zh: 林子里一点声音都没有。
lines.en: There is not a sound in the wood.
I stop and take a bite.
My shadow stretches long.
I walk deeper into the wood.
I press my feet into soft soil.
I walk toward an old tree.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的叶，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my leaves and I slap it out.
All four legs drive down on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的口鼻，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I cannot lift my head.

lines.zh: 炸风把我推得撞在树干上。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a trunk.
Something pins my shoulder.

lines.zh: 术式缠住我，藤都不动了。
lines.en: An art binds me and my vines stop.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到叶，我没劲了。
lines.en: Too long without leaves and I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I lock up.
No roots and no ground below.
